_comment: Site-authored, publishable captions for the gallery. The sidecars' own `description` fields are written maintainers-first and carry increment ids and decision numbers ("MM.6", "D-126 / D-127", "FA #73", "V.9 Session 4.5c"), so they cannot ship as-is. Each caption below is rewritten from its sidecar and asserts nothing the sidecar does not: first what the visitor is looking at, then what in the music drives it. Verify against the app repo before changing one. generate_presets.py merges these in; a preset with no entry here simply has no caption.
murmuration: A flock of starlings against a dusk sky. The music's energy sets how hard the flock churns and how far it drifts, each beat rolls a wave of banking through it, and the vocal line breathes in its density.
cymatic-resonance: Glowing sand on a resonating plate, collecting along the lines that stand still. Loudness drives how hard the plate vibrates, a beat makes the sand jump, and a shift in brightness selects a new figure — so the grains scatter and re-form on it.
ferrofluid-ocean: A ferrofluid ocean under an aurora. Bass raises the spikes, the music's intensity sets the swell beneath them, and the vocal line moves the aurora's color.
fractal-tree: A branching tree drawn in a few flat strokes, its color running from green at the first fork through blue and violet to magenta at the tips. It bounces on every beat and sways across the bar, the motion rippling outward so the finest branches follow a beat behind. Underneath it holds one size and steps to a new one when a sound lands — small in a sparse passage, full in a dense one.
skein: A painter pours continuous lines onto a canvas that never clears, so the picture builds up for as long as the track runs. Each instrument in the mix owns a color — the one carrying the moment pours the line while the others flick splatters across it — and fresh paint glistens before it dries matte.
nimbus: A single mass of glowing cool gas in a black void. The beat punches through it, the music's overall energy brightens the whole body, and bass, lead and the rest of the mix heave it down, up and sideways. As the music fills out the mass blooms bigger and brighter and the gas flows faster.
nebula: A radial reading of the spectrum — spokes of color thrown out from a bright core, wrapped in haze and sparkling particles. The ring tightens and blooms wide as the music fills out, and the spokes flare where the frequencies land.
nacre: A field of translucent mother-of-pearl cells, drifting and overlapping, their rims fringed with color. The palette travels with the song's harmony — the hue is positioned on the circle of fifths, so it holds through a vamp and drifts on a modulation — while the field swirls faster as the music fills out and surges on the downbeat.
aurora-veil: Looking up into an aurora — green curtains overhead across a starfield, warming toward magenta near the horizon. The stars keep the beat on the downbeat, while the veil breathes with the music's intensity and its color warms with the mood.
